name: Temozolomide, adjuvant / maintenance (5-day monthly)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Central Nervous System Cancers (general reference)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give a 5-HT3 antagonist before each daily dose; temozolomide is moderate emetic risk on the 5-day schedule.

supportiveCare: Take on an empty stomach at the same time each day for the 5-day pulse.
Continue PJP prophylaxis if lymphopenia persists from the concurrent phase.
Dose may be escalated from 150 to 200 mg/m2 from cycle 2 if cycle 1 was tolerated without significant myelosuppression.
monitoring: CBC on day 22 of each cycle and on day 1 before the next cycle (nadir counts guide the next dose)

drugs.name: Temozolomide
drugs.notes: 150 mg/m2 by mouth once daily on days 1 to 5 of a 28-day cycle, for up to 6 cycles; escalate to 200 mg/m2 from cycle 2 if the first cycle is well tolerated (adequate counts). Standard adjuvant / maintenance Stupp dose, also used as monotherapy in lower-grade glioma and at recurrence (NCCN CNS / DeVita, general reference; own wording).
